01570 galash {ga:-lash'}

字根型; TWOT - 357; 動詞

欽定本 - appear 2; 2

1) 坐, 坐起, (可能也指) 斜臥
   1a) (Qal) 用於指山羊群, 作為明喻, 形容女人的頭髮 (#歌 4:1; 6:5|)
record.edic_text:
01570 galash {gaw-lash'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 357; v

AV - appear 2; 2

1) to sit, sit up, (possibly also) recline
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) of flocks of goats
       1a2) of a woman's hair (simile)
